steps.title: Supply and Demand
steps.say: Let's start with a market at equilibrium, where the downward-sloping demand curve intersects the upward-sloping supply curve.

steps.title: Demand Increases
steps.say: When demand rises, consumers want to buy more at every price, shifting the entire demand curve to the right.

steps.title: New Equilibrium
steps.say: At the original price there is now a shortage, which pushes prices upward until quantity supplied expands to meet demand.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Both the equilibrium price and quantity have increased. Try dragging the curves to see how different shifts affect the market!
